create_conv_layer: create a Conv2d layer with optional batch normalization and ReLU activation
build_mlp_network: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable hidden dims, batchnorm, and dropout
init_weights: initialize Conv, BatchNorm2d, and Linear layer weights with normal distribution
build_visualnet: build a VisualNet feature extractor from a pretrained ResNet model
build_audionet: build an AudioNet feature extractor that adapts a ResNet for audio spectrogram input
